title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Points Validity and Expiry
content:
**1. Qualifying activity.** Ashbury Rewards points stay valid while the account shows qualifying activity: earning, a bonus, a purchase, a transfer given or received, or a redemption. The date of the last qualifying activity is the latest posted date among those transactions, or the enrolment date when there are none. When the tier's setting makes any activity restart the period, any one of them restarts the period for the whole balance.

**2. Expiry.** The balance expires only when the tier's number of inactive months have passed since the last qualifying activity. The months are counted from the posted date of the last qualifying activity; the balance expires on the same day number that many months later, or on the last day of that month when it has no such day, and points are still valid on the day before.

**3. Exempt tiers.** Members whose tier is exempt from inactivity expiry never lose points to inactivity.

**4. Removal.** The whole balance is removed in one inactivity expiry transaction; expired points are not reinstated.

**5. Closure.** When the account is closed the whole balance is removed as a closure forfeit when the tier's setting forfeits points on closure.

## Date cases (hypothetical dates, period of 24 months)

| Last qualifying activity | Balance expires on | Last day the points are valid |
|---|---|---|
| 15 May 2024 | 15 May 2026 | 14 May 2026 |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2026 (February 2026 has no 29th) | 27 February 2026 |
| 31 August 2024 | 31 August 2026 | 30 August 2026 |

## Points of judgement

- A redeposit, a stay credit reversal or a night credit is not among the qualifying activities listed in term 1.
- A member who asks to have expired points put back is outside term 4: expired points are not reinstated.
